This petition has been filed for quashing of the FIR No.404/2018 registered under Sections 498A/406/354/34 IPC at PS Vikaspuri, on the ground of settlement between the parties dated 26.07.2022, which is on record of this Court.
The matter has been settled amicably between the parties without any consideration.
The marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 has since been dissolved vide decree dated 03.11.2022.
One male child was born out of the wedlock.
2. Petitioner Nos.1 - 2 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in the Court, duly identified by the counsels and the IO.
Respondent No.2 states that she has no objection to the quashing of the said FIR.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 17:55:32 3.

Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.404/2018 registered under Sections 498A/406/354/34 IPC at PS Vikaspuri, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
It is however, made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
